interpretation_catalog.change_needs_context: This group appeared or increased in the observed comparison windows. Confirm application activity and collection coverage before interpreting the change.
interpretation_catalog.rule_match_not_intrusion_proof: A signature match is a starting point for review, not proof of an intrusion.
interpretation_catalog.sensor_reported_block: Suricata reported a blocked event. Confirm the associated client outcome; this does not prove every related request failed.
interpretation_catalog.stun_may_be_normal: STUN is used for NAT traversal. Conferencing, games or other applications may explain it; process identity and intent are not established.
interpretation_catalog.uid_fixture_possible: This rule can match a harmless UID-response fixture. Verify the exact request against the owned test receipt before treating it as expected.
